# RE IMAGE Business Solutions

> Hartford-based business systems company and publisher of a verified Hartford local business directory.

## Primary URLs

- [Homepage](https://reimagebs.com/): Custom websites, customer portals, payment systems, automation, and connected business operating systems.
- [Hartford Local Business Directory](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace.html): Search verified Hartford-area businesses by service, specialty, and town.
- [New Britain Avenue Hartford Business Guide](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace/guides/new-britain-avenue-hartford/): Block-by-block guide to food, fresh drinks, and African hair braiding.
- [Directory methodology](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace/about/): Verification, corrections, ranking, and placement-label policy.
- [Complete machine-readable directory](https://reimagebs.com/llms-full.txt): Full verified listing summaries and direct links.
- [Marketplace JSON feed](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace-feed.json): Structured public listing data.
- [XML sitemap](https://reimagebs.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public URLs and image discovery.

## Hartford directory categories

- [Restaurants & Drinks](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace/categories/restaurants-drinks/): Juice bars, Caribbean favorites, Mexican fusion, takeout, catering, and signature Hartford flavors.
- [Nightlife & Events](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace/categories/nightlife-events/): Cocktails, live entertainment, private events, and memorable nights out in Hartford.
- [Auto Body & Towing](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace/categories/auto-body-towing/): Collision repair, paint, mechanical service, towing, and online estimates near Hartford.
- [Car Rentals](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace/categories/car-rentals/): Local cars, SUVs, trucks, luxury vehicles, and passenger vans available to reserve online.
- [Skincare & Esthetics](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace/categories/skincare-esthetics/): Corrective and customized skincare for acne, hyperpigmentation, texture, and personal care.
- [Hair & Braiding](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace/categories/hair-braiding/): African braiding, protective styles, extensions, twists, locs, and personalized styling.
- [Printing & Custom Apparel](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace/categories/printing-apparel/): Custom apparel, embroidery, signs, banners, uniforms, promotional products, and print services.
- [Real Estate & Rentals](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace/categories/real-estate-rentals/): Residential and commercial rentals, property management, and Hartford-area development.
- [Community & Family](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace/categories/community-family/): Mentorship, gatherings, resources, and support designed to strengthen families and communities.
- [Private Transportation](https://reimagebs.com/marketplace/categories/private-transportation/): Private chauffeur service for airports, corporate travel, events, and long-distance trips.

## Key facts

- Geographic focus: Hartford and Greater Hartford, Connecticut.
- Listings use official business links and verified storefront addresses or truthful service areas.
- Profiles include specialties, direct actions, factual FAQs, and the information verification date.
- Businesses outside Greater Hartford are separated from Hartford-area listings.
- No fabricated ratings, copied reviews, or unsupported ranking claims are published.
